faq.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Surat?
faq.a: It depends on the channels and ad budget you want to run. We build a plan around your goals and give a clear monthly quote with no lock-in surprises.

faq.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
faq.a: Local SEO can show movement in a few weeks, but competitive rankings usually take three to six months of consistent work. We report progress the whole way.

faq.q: Do you manage the ad budget too?
faq.a: Yes. We set up, run, and optimize your Google and Meta ad spend, and report exactly where the money goes and what it returns.

faq.q: Can you guarantee the number one ranking?
faq.a: No honest agency can guarantee a specific Google ranking — anyone who does is a red flag. We commit to steady, measurable improvement instead.

faq.q: Which platforms should my business be on?
faq.a: That depends on where your customers are. We recommend a focused mix rather than spreading thin across every platform at once.
